newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - June 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - June 19.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Parbatya Chattyagram Jana Shanghati Samity, the political wing of tribal Shanti Bahini insugents, has proposed to hold next round of peace talks on July 14.
A joint committee set up to monitor the Bangladesh-India water sharing treaty began a two-day review meeting in Dhaka on Wednesday.
All equipment required for extinguishing a gas field fire in northeast Moulavi Bazar would reach within a day or two but the blaze may continue for weeks, Occidental sources said.
Some 10 firms have applied for permission to run air service on domestic routes.

The main opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) on Wednesday warned to launch an oust-government movement next week if it does not withdraw the enhanced prices of fertiliser and new taxes in the proposed budget.
A visiting team of Communist Party of India (CPI) on Wednesday expressed satifaction at the improving ties between Dhaka and New Delhi.
Five firms have obatained the letters of intent for setting up merchant banks.
Foreign Minister Abdus Samnad Azad on Wednesday said the government would appoint a good number of "roving ambassadors" for establishing quick links with foreign investors. REUTER
